title: Menzel Armor Study
content: This small study of armor by Adolph Menzel (1815-1905) sold at auction last month for two million Euros. The pre-sale estimate was estimated between €100,000 and €150,000.Menzel did several studies of armor in the 1860s, and they all have a lifelike quality, as if they're animated and looking at you.Link to articleThanks, ChristianGJ Post onpainting in an armory
